question: Which sport had the most Arjuna Award recipients in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Para-Athletics**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Para-Athletics** had the most recipients of the **Arjuna Awards** in January 2025, recognizing the exceptional achievements of Indian athletes with disabilities in various sports disciplines.
 
• The **Arjuna Award** is one of India's most prestigious national sports honors, aimed at acknowledging outstanding performance in sports and games.
 
• A significant number of **Para-Athletes** received the Arjuna Award due to their remarkable contributions, including medals in international competitions such as the **Paralympics** and World Para-Athletics Championships.
 
• The increased recognition for Para-Athletics showcases India's focus on promoting **inclusive sports culture** and supporting athletes with disabilities.
 
• Prominent awardees include athletes excelling in events like **track and field, wheelchair sports, and powerlifting**, among others, making Para-Athletics the leading category in terms of awardees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Arjuna Award:**

 
 
• Established in **1961**, the Arjuna Award honors excellence in sports and is conferred by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
 
• Recipients are selected based on their performance at **national and international levels**, as well as their ability to inspire others through sports.
 
• The award includes a **bronze statuette of Arjuna**, a certificate, and a cash prize.
 
• It recognizes achievements in both **Olympic and Paralympic sports**, as well as indigenous and non-Olympic sports.
 
 
 
• **Para-Athletics:**
 
 
• Para-Athletics is a category of sports designed for athletes with physical disabilities, featuring events like **running, jumping, throwing, and wheelchair racing**.
 
• India has made significant strides in Para-Athletics, with athletes like **Devendra Jhajharia** and **Mariyappan Thangavelu** achieving global recognition.
 
• The **Paralympic Games** serve as the pinnacle event for Para-Athletes, offering opportunities to compete at the highest level.
 
• India's Para-Athletes have brought home numerous medals from events like the **Tokyo 2020 Paralympics**, boosting awareness and support for disabled athletes.
 
 
 
• **Inclusive Sports Initiatives:**
 
 
• The Government of India has launched several schemes to promote sports among disabled individuals, such as the **Khelo India Programme**.
 
• Specialized training centers and funding mechanisms have been established to provide **world-class facilities** and support for Para-Athletes.
 
• Programs like **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** have been extended to Para-Athletes, ensuring they receive adequate financial and coaching support.
 
 
 
• **Other Sports Categories:**
 
 
• **Hockey:** Historically a popular category for Arjuna Award recipients due to India’s legacy in international hockey tournaments.
 
• **Athletics:** Covers track and field events, with awardees often excelling in international competitions like the Olympics and Asian Games.
 
• **Shooting:** A high-achieving category where Indian shooters have won multiple medals in events like the Olympics and Commonwealth Games.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Recognition for Para-Athletes:**

 
 
• Para-Athletes receiving the Arjuna Award signifies growing support for inclusive sports.
 
• India’s performance in Para-Athletics on global platforms has led to increased acknowledgment and funding opportunities.
 
• These awards encourage more disabled individuals to pursue sports professionally.
 
 
 
• **Role of Government:**
 
 
• Various government schemes, including the **National Sports Development Fund**, aim to support athletes with disabilities.
 
• The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports ensures that Para-Athletes have access to **modern equipment, training, and coaching facilities**.
 
• Government recognition through awards like Arjuna highlights the importance of fostering an inclusive environment in sports.
